title.p: Chapter 1092: Fall of silkwyrm, world in chaos (2)

section.p: Silkwyrm Realm.
This was a massive world.

At the center of the world was a floating palace. A massive silk cocoon could be seen in the palace. At the tip of the cocoon was a dragon-like head. This was the origin of the name of the silkwyrm race.

Suddenly, the massive silkwyrm was roused awake. He instantly transformed into a humanoid form. Clad in a white outfit, Silkwyrm King walked out of the palace. As he whirled his fingers in the air, streams of incorporeal power converged around him from all over the realm.
His expression changed slightly as he started looking around. One Sunmoon after another appeared before him.
“King, what’s happening?”
“King, what task do you have for us?”
The Sunmoons were alarmed to see the nervous expression of their king.
“Most likely.”

But Silkwyrm King remained silent. This was too bizarre. He was feeling an intense sense of crisis, but at the same time, it also didn’t feel all too dangerous. He was not aware that his muddled crisis sense was caused by Great Zhou King.

Great Zhou King, the person known as the old turtle by Su Yu, was here. If Su Yu could comprehend the calm and patience characters from Great Zhou King’s willpower text, just imagine what Great Zhou King could do himself.
He was the number one expert of the Knowledge Seeking Realm. He was also the number one human cultural researcher. And one of the three strongest humans in existence.

All these titles were the source of his fame and prestige. Among the human Invincibles, only a few of them had killed other Invincibles before. Among them were Great Qin King, Great Xia King, and Great Zhou King.
There were more who had also killed Invincibles before, but for the most part, they had done so fighting with number on their side.

Great Ming King had never killed an Invincible before, but he considered the divine Invincible who had been eaten by the big furball during the battle with him his kill. Since he did not provide the corpse to back his claim, most people ignored his proclamation.
And two of the human Invincibles who had killed other Invincibles alone had arrived at the Silkwyrm Realm.
Near the realm entrance.

With one swing of Great Xia King’s blade, everything in its path was decimated. All the silkwyrm experts stationed near the entrance were destroyed, regardless of whether they were Mountainseas or Sunmoons.
Looking at the center of the realm, Great Xia King said, “Wang Hu, you’ll watch the realm entrance. I’ll kill him with Old Zhou.”
“Alright.”
Great Han King did not mind. A realm might be connected to the Allheaven Battlefield, but when one destroyed the realm, one might emerge in the boundless void instead of the Allheaven Battlefield.
The so-called boundless void was the birthplace of the heavenearth profound light. One could also reach the boundless void from the Allheaven Battlefield by breaking through void itself.
And one of Great Xia King’s favorite hobbies was waiting at the boundless void near the Divine Realm. One could say that he was a frequent visitor of that place.

Meanwhile, Silk Destroying King seemed dissatisfied with this arrangement. He complained, “I want to take my revenge with my own hands. You also need me to kill his past body or he might be able to escape…”
Great Xia King glanced at Silk Destroying King and said, “Do you think your Time technique is better than what I can do?”
He couldn’t be bothered to entertain Silk Destroying King. They had to complete this task and leave as soon as possible.

If they dragged this out for too long or the battle started attracting too much attention, the divines and devils might interfere. Sure, they would be suppressed in the Silkwyrm Realm, but they didn’t have to do that. As long as the Silkwyrm Realm was destroyed, everyone would emerge in the boundless void. There, they could still attempt to save Silkwyrm King.

The human race was here to make an example out of someone. If they failed even after sending a few of their strongest Invincibles on this mission, their reputation would be completely ruined. With a flicker, both Great Xia King and Great Zhou King vanished.
Inside the floating palace.
Silkwyrm King was still feeling uneasy. What was happening? He was feeling both uneasy and calm at the same time. The two intertwined together, creating a complicated mix of emotions.
He was anxious. Suddenly, he thought of something. He hurriedly tried splitting space apart to leave. But before he could leave, a radiant blade appeared. The sky was split into two.
The radiant blade captured the attention of everyone in the Silkwyrm Realm. It was too powerful and shocking, its appearance enveloping the entire Silkwyrm Realm in a heavy pressure.
“Great Xia King!”
Fear, terror, and despair. With a roar, Silkwyrm King turned into a massive silkwyrm before flying away, trying to flee from the blade.
Great Xia King.
Great Xia King of the human race and the Sky Sundering Saber.
With a look of despair, he bellowed, “For invading a minor realm and killing me, the human race will incur the joint hostility of the myriad races! You can’t do this, Great Xia King!”
He roared with desperation.

Two other Silkwyrm Kings appeared as well. All three of them worked together to tear space apart, revealing the River of Time. But compared with Devil King’s River of Time, this river was more akin to a stream than an actual river.
The blade descended. The river ruptured.

Finally, Great Xia King became visible. Without saying anything, the three Silkwyrm Kings fled in different directions. But right at that moment, a refined cultivator in white robes appeared noiselessly out of nowhere. With a casual grab, space itself solidified and formed a net big enough to envelop the entire realm.
The net started shrinking. Silkwyrm King sank into further despair.
“No! Great Zhou King!”
Two of the three strongest human Invincibles had actually come to kill him!
Together!

The last time such a combination appeared, it was for the sake of facing the Devil Pseudo Emperor. Yes. Back then, Great Xia King and Great Zhou King once joined hands against the Devil Pseudo Emperor. A combination like this was far from what he could handle. In fact, Great Xia King alone was already enough to send him into the depths of despair. What hope did he have with Great Zhou King added into the equation as well?
“No! You can’t do this! I was born from the primal chaos! After ages upon ages of cultivation, I finally became the supreme god of the Silkwyrm Realm! You can’t do this to me!”

Silkwyrm King couldn’t see any hope. The two Invincibles didn’t even feel like saying anything to him. They merely faced him with indifference. Once again, the blade lit up, followed by a resounding rumble.

One blade after another dropped. There were too many of them to count. This was the Sky Sundering Countless Saber. Finally, one of the tri-life bodies perished. Great Xia King reached out and pulled a branch into his hand.

In comparison, Great Zhou King’s moves were much less conspicuous. One character after another appeared and swarmed the other tri-life body. In the blink of an eye, the characters faded away, revealing a black hole in place of the tri-life body.

With that, only a single tri-life body remained. With a roar of desperation, Silkwyrm King ripped the sky apart. A massive black hole appeared. He rushed into the black hole without any hesitation. Evidently, he was planning to leave everything behind and run for his life. But right at that moment, his voice rang out again.
“No! Great Han King! No, you can’t do this!”

He could not believe that three powerful Eternals had been deployed just to kill him. Had the human race gone crazy? He was absolutely not important enough to earn the attention of three Invincibles at once.
At that moment, an annoyed voice rang out, “Fuck! Why didn’t you run this way? Am I really not getting my revenge?”
“Wang Hu!”

With a punch from Great Han King, Silkwyrm King’s body started breaking apart. When he heard Silk Destroying King’s voice, he roared, “This is all your fault! This wouldn’t have happened if it wasn’t for you! Wang Hu, I will walk out of the River of Time yet again! I will kill you!”
A River of Time unfurled in the sky.
Stepping atop the river, Silk Destroying King laughed, “Come. Come kill me. I’ll kill you first!”

Right after saying that, the river landed on Silkwyrm King. Instantly, Silkwyrm King’s aura dropped while his body shrunk as Silk Destroying King landed kick after kick on him. Finally, Silkwyrm King was reduced into a tiny worm with an incredibly weak aura.

With a smile, Silk Destroying King grabbed the worm and sighed, “You only have yourself to blame for swallowing me back then. I guess I’ll have to change my name from Silk Destroying King into something else after today.”

He crushed the tiny worm in his palm. The entire Silkwyrm Realm started shaking violently, as though it was on the verge of collapse. Silkwyrm King was the master of this world. And the master had perished.
At the same time. Allheaven Battlefield.
Everyone was still focusing on the ancient city.

Suddenly, massive rumbles reverberated all over the Allheaven Battlefield. Lightning flashes appeared in the sky, and a massive storm raged across the Allheaven Battlefield. The weather of the Allheaven Battlefield had always remained stable, so this storm came as a surprise. Then, a blinding star started falling from the starry skies.

While falling, the incomparably massive star transformed into a silkwyrm. It continued its fall, accompanied by a crimson radiance around it. The desperation on the face of the silkwyrm was visible for all to see.
The crimson light spread from the Silkwyrm Realm across the entire sky.

Everyone was alarmed. All the gazes that were previously on the ancient city shifted toward the crimson light. One Invincible after another emerged from their realm entrances. Incomparably powerful auras rippled across the entire Allheaven Battlefield.

Had the final war between all the realms arrived? An Invincible had actually perished? This was the first Invincible to die in fifty-one years. Even the two recent battles involving Invincibles in ancient cities had only caused the loss of some tri-life bodies. No Invincible had actually died.

But so soon after the latest chaos, an Invincible had actually died. Silkwyrm King had died. That was a relatively strong Invincible. Someone like that had died. Judging from the direction the crimson light was coming from, he had died in his own realm.
At the next moment, four incomparably powerful silhouettes appeared amid the crimson light.
Four human Invincibles.
Under countless shocked gazes, the four Invincibles started flying eastward.
